text:
这份 14 页中文路演 PPT 做了结构改版，新增/重做了 3 页，请完整逐页验收（标准：能直接上台讲）。

改动：
- 第 9 页全新「地图算法」：左侧 01 切 / 02 找 / 03 画 / 04 补 四步 + 底部公式；右侧一张大 Web 地图截图（纸面）+ 两张小截图（户外 / 夜间）+ 说明。
- 第 11 页 App 改为两张真机截图（左：骑行页；右：设备页）+ 右侧 5 条功能清单 + 底部一句。
- 第 13 页「整机自研，全栈开源」三栏 + 新增「板级约定」一行 + 边界说明；原独立的「回馈」页已并入本页。
- 其余页仅页码顺延。

重点看：第 9 页三张截图比例/间距/图注、左侧四步是否溢出；第 11 页手机截图是否变形、两只手机框是否等高、右列是否压到截图；第 13 页三栏 + 两条分隔线 + 边界文案是否拥挤或压线；全篇页码 01–14 是否连续。

PNG：/home/jinsc/SDK/vela/ppt/.build/render9/s-01.png 至 s-14.png。

每页一行 JSON：{"page":N,"verdict":"pass|fail","issues":["具体到元素与位置"],"fix":"一句可执行修法"}。最后一句总体判断。

thinking:
I'm a visual acceptance reviewer. I need to review 14 PNG pages at /home/jinsc/SDK/vela/ppt/.build/render9/s-01.png through s-14.png. Let me read them one by one and give verdicts.

The dispatch message asks for a specific JSON format: {"page":N,"verdict":"pass|fail","issues":["具体到元素与位置"],"fix":"一句可执行修法"} — one line per page, plus a final overall judgment sentence.

Let me read the images. I should read them one by one, writing each page's verdict after reading. But I can batch independent reads. The workflow says "Read your page images one by one, writing each page's verdict immediately after reading it." I can make multiple independent calls in one block though. Let me read them in batches to be efficient, but carefully evaluate each.

Let me start.

Page 1: Cover slide, dark background, "Helm One" title, device screenshot on right showing a bike computer dashboard. Looks clean. Screenshot looks proportional, caption below "P02 · 表盘页 20.5 km/h". No page number visible on page 1 (cover — often cover has no page number; that's a design choice). The user asks to check page numbers 01-14 continuity — page 2 shows "02 / 14" bottom right. Cover without number is acceptable convention. Pass.

Page 2: "车把上，不需要一块手机" with 01 反光 / 02 手套 / 03 没网 on left, right side "码表的第一性原理：抬头 0.5 秒，看清一个数。" Page number "02 / 14" bottom right. Layout looks balanced. Left column ends at ~80% height, right column text ends around middle. Slight imbalance but acceptable. Pass.

Continue reading pages 3-4.

Page 3: "四个不背妥协的选择" — four rows with big numbers, right side device screenshot with map + caption "P01 · 地图首页". Clean. Page number "03 / 14". Pass.

Page 4: "从开发板，到能上路的整机" — left three stacked cards (感知/计算/呈现) with connector lines, right list of 5 items. Clean, balanced. Page number "04 / 14". Pass.

Continue 5-6.

Page 5: "不是贴片，是在 openvela 上做整机" — six stacked layer rows (APP/LINK/HELM/BSP/OS/SoC), right side three stats (19 / 6 / A2.0). Clean. Page number "05 / 14". Pass.

Page 6: "为一块屏，画一套 UI" — three device screenshots on the left with captions P05 仪表台 / P03 全数字 / P07 菜单; status bar strip below; right column with 图形栈/信息架构/半透半反/图标. The third screenshot (P07 菜单) shows a menu partially — the bottom of the menu screen shows "屏" text partially cut ("界面"?). Looking at the third screenshot, the bottom shows "系统" section and partially visible item "屏..." which appears cut off at device bottom edge. That's the device screen crop — the screenshot inside the device frame shows a menu list that continues below the visible area; a screen that is cropped at the device bezel is natural (it's a screen). The visible content: 蓝牙设备, 工具箱, then "系统" label and a partially visible row starting with "屏" — it looks like a partially rendered row at the bottom edge of the screen. This is a screen recording crop at device bottom, natural. It's fine — the content inside is cut by the device frame, which is normal for a scrollable screen. All three same height, captions aligned. Pass.

Page number "06 / 14". Pass.

Continue 7-8.

Page 7: performance bars page. Four bars, values, red percentages. The bar for "导航投影" is dark green while others are black — a deliberate emphasis choice probably. "改前 → 改后" header, "变化" header. Bottom three footnotes ①②③, source note. Page number "07 / 14". Looks clean, no overlap. Pass.

Page 8: map page, left a large map screenshot with caption "P04 · 地图页局部：真机矢量底图", right four stat rows with divider lines. The map screenshot: aspect ratio looks natural (4:3-ish). The bottom of map shows "200m" scale bar partially cut? It shows "200m" fully. "攀洁路" partially cut at bottom edge — that's within a screen crop; caption says 局部 (partial view). Fine. Page number "08 / 14". Pass.

Now the critical pages 9, 10, 11.

Page 9 — the new "地图算法" page. Left side: 01 切 / 02 找 / 03 画 / 04 补 four steps with divider lines between them, bottom formula x(y+1) = x(y) + dx/dy and note. Right side: one large paper map screenshot + two small screenshots stacked (outdoor / night) + caption line "HTML 试验台：纸面 / 户外 / 夜间。同一份 STYLE.md 驱动 Web、模拟器、板端。"

Check details:
- Left steps: text doesn't appear to overflow; each step's text wraps to two lines within the left column (~55% width). Dividers between steps look fine. No overflow visible past the right edge of left column? The step text "PBF → 3 km 网格 → 256×256 矢量瓦片；北京演示包 64 区 / 0.4 MB" wraps within the column. Looks fine.
- Large map screenshot: aspect ratio natural, not stretched. It appears crisp.
- Two small screenshots on right: top one (户外) — wait, the top small one appears to be... the top-right small image looks like a map at lower zoom (户外 daylight?), the bottom one is dark (夜间). Both look natural aspect.
- Spacing between the small images and large one: there's a gap, looks fine.
- Caption below aligned with large image bottom.
- One thing to check: does the top small image (户外) actually look like "户外" (outdoor high-contrast)? It looks like a lighter, washed-out map, consistent with 户外 styling. OK.
- Formula at bottom left "x(y+1) = x(y) + dx/dy" and note below. Fine.
- Left column bottom: 04 补 text ends around y≈800; formula at ~900. No crowding.
- Page number "09 / 14". Header "08 — 地图算法". Consistent.

Wait, section numbers in header: page 2 header "01 — 问题", page 3 "02 — 产品", page 4 "03 — 整机", page 5 "04 — 架构", page 6 "05 — 图形", page 7 "06 — 性能", page 8 "07 — 地图", page 9 "08 — 地图算法", page 10 "09 — 导航". Consistent sequence. Page number bottom right: 02/14 through 10/14 so far. Good.

Page 9: the two small screenshots — are they the same height? The top one (户外) appears slightly shorter than bottom (夜间)? Looking at the image: top small image spans roughly y=255-480, bottom spans y=490-710. They look about equal height. The large image spans y=255-780 approx. The bottom of large image ~780, bottom of night image ~710 — so the small column ends higher than the large image. Caption is placed below the large image, spanning under both. Slight raggedness but acceptable? The user specifically asked to check "三张截图比例/间距/图注". Let me zoom into page 9 to verify precisely. I could crop portions using bash? I shouldn't re-render, but cropping the PNG for closer inspection is reading, not re-rendering. The instruction says re-rendering of any kind is forbidden; cropping an image for inspection is not re-rendering the deck. But do I have image tools? I could use Python PIL to crop and save... but that would write into the workspace — "never write into the deliverable or the workspace". I can write to /tmp maybe. Hmm, "review only — edit nothing; never write into the deliverable or the workspace". Writing temp crops to /tmp is borderline but it's not the workspace deliverable; it aids inspection. I think using Read on the PNG at full size already gave a decent view. The images render at 2000px wide, and Read shows them downscaled. For fine detail like pixel overflow, a crop would help. I'll allow crops in /tmp (outside the deliverable/workspace). Actually, let me be careful — writing files anywhere as a reviewer... The prohibition is about editing the deliverable/workspace; /tmp crops for inspection seem acceptable and commonly needed. I'll do a couple of crops for pages 9, 11, 13 to verify details.

Page 10: navigation flow, 5 numbered circles with connector lines, step 4 highlighted orange. Titles + descriptions. Bottom: divider + bold statement + gray note. There's a large empty gap between the steps row (ends ~y=530) and the bottom divider (~y=815). The middle band of the page is empty — is that a visible imbalance? The layout has steps at top, statement at bottom; middle empty space is substantial (~300px of 1125). It's a deliberate airy layout? Hmm. "visible imbalance (visual center off, one side overloaded while the other sits empty)" — here the emptiness is horizontal band, not one side. This is a design choice with generous whitespace; many decks do this. The steps row occupies the top third, bottom statement at bottom. It reads as finished. I'd lean pass. But let me look again: the gap between step descriptions end (~y 530) and divider (~y 815) is large but the statement anchors the bottom. Not a defect per se.

Page 10 header "09 — 导航", page number "10 / 14". Good.

Now pages 11 and 12.

Page 11 — App page with two phone screenshots. Check:
- Left phone (骑行 page): dark UI, looks like a real device screenshot. Not distorted. Right phone (设备 page): dark UI with list. Both phones have dark bezels.
- Are the two phone frames equal height? Left phone spans roughly y=248-835; right phone spans y=250-830. They look approximately equal. Captions below: "骑行 · 周目标 / 本周记录" and "设备 · 通知 / 固件 / 星历 / 离线图". Caption baseline looks aligned.
- Right column 5 items: 规划 / 通知 / 星历 / 升级 / 离线, with divider lines. Does the right column press against the screenshots? The right column starts at x≈830; the right phone ends at x≈745. Gap is fine.
- Bottom statement "没有账号，没有骑行云；不装 App 也能骑。" + "Flutter 3 · 中英双语" at bottom right area. It's below the right column, aligned left with right column. Fine.
- One thing: the right phone's screen content — bottom nav shows 骑行/设备/设置 icons, 设备 highlighted orange. The left phone bottom nav shows same. Both look like real screenshots. The left phone's stat area: "本周 0/4 次, 0/5h, 0.0/50 km" — dark theme. Looks fine.
- The phones: do they appear distorted? Both appear normal proportions (roughly 9:19.5 phone aspect). Let me measure roughly: left phone x≈110-400 (290 wide), y≈248-835 (587 tall) → ratio 2.02. Right phone x≈440-745 (305 wide), y≈250-830 (580) → 1.9. Hmm, those are rough eyeball numbers; both around 2:1 height:width, plausible phone aspect. Not obviously stretched.

Wait — are the two phone frames equal height? Left ~587, right ~580 — within eyeball tolerance, can't confidently claim a mismatch. Let me crop to compare precisely. I'll do a quick pixel analysis using Python with PIL to find the phone frame bounding boxes. That's inspection, allowed (read-only), writing crops to /tmp.

Actually — I can compute bounding boxes without saving crops, just print numbers. That's fine.

Page 12: "8.9 小时，0 次看门狗" — dark slide, big orange "0" left with caption "次看门狗复位" and "单次开机 31,965 s（8.9 h）", right three sections with dividers. Bottom source line. Page number "12 / 14". Balanced: left has big 0, right three blocks. There's empty space at bottom right below third block, but source line anchors. Fine. Pass.

Now pages 13, 14. Then do pixel checks for 9 and 11 details.

Page 13: "整机自研，全栈开源" — three columns: 自研 / 基于 / 可复现, each with a short top divider, red label, then content. Then a full-width divider line, "板级约定" red label + text row, another full-width divider, then "自研部分 Apache-2.0；地图数据按 ODbL 署名；上游改动随仓库提交，不宣称已合入。" and a smaller gray line "演示场景对应 7 步全流程，一条命令复跑；模拟器与板端同一份 LVGL 源码。". Page number "13 / 14".

Check crowding/pressing: The middle band between three-column content (ends ~y 490) and 板级约定 divider (~y 655) has whitespace; the rows below are well spaced. Text doesn't touch divider lines. The three columns: column content "板级 · 骑行应用 · Flutter App · 地图工具链" wraps in two lines; "openvela · NuttX · LVGL · OpenStreetMap（ODbL）" two lines; "模拟器跑真 UI · 29 个演示场景 · 构建约 10 分钟" two lines. Balanced. No crowding. Pass.

Page 14: closing dark slide "让 openvela 从手腕，走到车把。" with device boot screen on right (white screen with logo + "Helm One"), caption "开机 · 启动页 → 地图首页". Page number "14 / 14". Fine. Pass.

Page numbers observed: 02/14 ... 14/14 all consistent; page 1 (cover) has no visible page number — typical for covers. Continuity 01–14: cover = 1 (implied), 02 through 14 explicit. That's continuous.

Now let me verify the specific fine details on pages 9 and 11 with pixel-level checks, since the dispatcher flagged them:

Page 9: three screenshots ratio/spacing/captions; left four steps overflow.
Page 11: phone distortion, equal frame heights, right column pressing screenshots.

I'll run a Python analysis using PIL to measure bounding boxes of bright regions. Need PIL available. Let me check and run. Use python3 -I with a script from /tmp? "pass paths as arguments instead of running an interpreter or build tool inside it" — write script to /tmp and run with absolute paths. Writing a script to /tmp is fine (not the workspace).

Actually simpler: use python3 -c inline with -I. The -I flag ignores env and doesn't add cwd to sys.path. Inline code is fine.

Measure page 11 phone frames: detect the dark bezel regions on the left half. The background is light (#f2f0eb-ish). Phones are dark. Threshold pixels darker than, say, luminance < 100 in region x<800, find bounding boxes of the two connected components.

Page 9: measure the three map images' bounding boxes (they're on light background but the map colors are light too...). The paper map is light beige, outdoor light, night dark. Harder. Alternative: crop and view at higher zoom. Reading the PNG via Read gives me the full view already; a crop of specific region rendered at native resolution would let me see edges more precisely. Let me crop page 9's right area and page 11's phones area, save crops to /tmp, and Read them.

Let me do that.
